description:
This is a puzzle game where you create rooms by dividing grid spaces with colors to form point-symmetric shapes centered around the gems.
You clear the stage once all the gems are separated into different rooms.

There are 1,000 stages in total. 
It’s a challenging puzzle game that tests your powers of insight.
name: Symmetrical logic puzzles 1000
intro: A luxurious puzzle game where you separate scattered gems into different rooms. However, the rooms must be point-symmetric with the gems at the center.
